holderQuote: Valeterisa looked unconvinced herself. She took a carrot and sipped at a cup of tea. Her face fell.
effectQuote: That’s a lot of raw vegetables…and I hate potatoes!

holderQuote: Valeterisa turned. She peered at Bezale.
effectQuote: “Hm. Minotaur. Female. You must be Bezale, contact of…[Recall Memories]. Scriptels. Note on record about loyalty. Mage Montressa. Hello.”
